records.title: Use import attributes for NodeNext JSON imports
records.summary: TypeScript 5.8 reports TS2880 for a static JSON import with an import assertion under NodeNext.
conditions: An ESM file in a NodeNext project uses import ... assert { type: 'json' }.
actions: Replace assert with with and verify the runtime accepts import attributes.
verification: Run the owning typecheck and load the emitted module using the target Node version.

records.title: Use ArrayBuffer-backed bytes for Blob parts
records.summary: TypeScript 5.9 rejects a Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike> in a BlobPart position.
conditions: The project types input as Uint8Array and passes it to a DOM API requiring ArrayBuffer-backed bytes.
actions: Keep the narrower buffer type if guaranteed, or copy the view with new Uint8Array(bytes) before creating the Blob.
verification: Rerun typecheck and verify that the Blob preserves the incoming byte range.

records.title: Use the DOM realm for EventTarget checks
records.summary: An EventTarget from a separate jsdom script realm no longer inherits from the Node host Object after the prototype change.
conditions: The tests use runScripts: 'outside-only' or 'dangerously' and compare realm-created objects against host constructors.
actions: Use constructors from the object’s window, or explicitly check for the needed behavior across realms.
verification: Run the owning DOM tests, including a separate jsdom realm and the default realm if both are used.

records.title: Migrate jsdom VirtualConsole forwarding
records.summary: The old sendTo method forwards page logs on the source, and is absent in the target. forwardTo preserves the tested log forwarding.
conditions: Test environment code configures VirtualConsole.sendTo, especially with omitJSDOMErrors.
actions: Use forwardTo with jsdomErrors: 'none' when the older option intentionally suppressed forwarding. Keep explicit listeners if they are used for assertions.
verification: Run the owning DOM tests and confirm page logs and relevant jsdom errors still reach their intended consumers.

negativeControls.name: hold-old-contract
negativeControls.fixtureAssertion: assert.throws(() => legacyConsole(end), /sendTo is not a function/);

records.title: Adopt the new optional jsdom canvas backend
records.summary: The target no longer declares canvas and instead declares @napi-rs/canvas with range ^1.0.13. The fixture verifies the manifest change and a DOM without the native peer.
conditions: The tests use optional jsdom canvas drawing, image decoding, or custom fonts with canvas ^3.0.0.
actions: Install a compatible @napi-rs/canvas release. Review direct backend calls and avoid assuming unchanged encoded output.
verification: Install on the actual CI platform and rerun drawing, font, image decoding, and snapshot assertions.

records.title: Replace jsdom ResourceLoader instances
records.summary: The ResourceLoader export disappears in the target. A resources options object preserves the fixture’s navigator.userAgent value.
conditions: The project passes a ResourceLoader instance to JSDOM to configure an agent or overrides resource-loading behavior.
actions: Move settings such as userAgent into resources options. Follow the release guide to port any custom fetch overrides to supported interceptors.
verification: Rerun tests for page resources and assert the resulting agent, response, and error handling.

records.title: Align Node.js with the target engine range
records.summary: The published source accepts Node.js 12.22.12 under >=12.20. The target excludes it under >=14.17.
conditions: Local development, deployment, or CI retains a Node.js version accepted by the source but outside >=14.17.
actions: Update the runtime pins to a supported Node.js version in >=14.17 before installing the target.
verification: Check the actual runtime in each environment, install with engine-strict, and run the owning project checks.

records.title: Fix the source or compiler option rejected by the target
records.summary: The exact target compiler emits TS5110 for a fixture accepted by the source. The updated fixture typechecks on 5.2.2.
conditions: The compiler config uses moduleResolution Node16 with a different module mode.
actions: Match the module and moduleResolution options to Node16.
verification: Run the owning workspace's typecheck using its real compiler configuration.

records.title: Fix the source or compiler option rejected by the target
records.summary: The exact target compiler emits TS2855 for a fixture accepted by the source. The updated fixture typechecks on 5.3.2.
conditions: Subclass code accesses a superclass instance field through super.
actions: Access the field through the instance or expose behavior through a superclass method.
verification: Run the owning workspace's typecheck using its real compiler configuration.
